from pathlib import Path
import sqlite3
cands = list(Path(".").glob("**/*.db"))
print("dbs", [str(p) for p in cands[:30]])
for pp in cands:
    if pp.stat().st_size == 0: continue
    try:
        c=sqlite3.connect(pp)
        t=set(r[0] for r in c.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type=\"table\""))
    except Exception as e:
        continue
    interesting = sorted(x for x in t if any(k in x for k in ("exchange","fill","llm","funnel","protection")))
    if not interesting: continue
    print("---", pp)
    print("tables", interesting)
    for tbl in ["exchange_orders","exchange_fill_receipts","llm_invocations","decision_funnel_terminals"]:
        if tbl in t:
            n=c.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {tbl}").fetchone()[0]
            print(tbl, n)
'@; Write-Host "---logs---"; Get-ChildItem logs -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name,Length,LastWriteTime | Format-Table -AutoSize; Write-Host "---p2---"; Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Path . -Filter "checklist.json" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName; Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Path logs -Filter "*runtime*" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object FullName
